name: @explorin/marketing
description: Explorin public site on Cloudflare Workers: landing page and waitlist (D1).

scripts.sync-brand: rm -rf static/brand && mkdir -p static/brand && cp ../../packages/brand/svg/lockup-horizontal-ink.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/lockup-horizontal-cream.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/favicon.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/pattern-tile.svg ../../packages/brand/svg/mark-orange.svg ../../packages/brand/png/og-card-green-1200.png ../../packages/brand/png/app-icon-green-180.png static/brand/
scripts.dev: npm run sync-brand && npm run db:migrate:local && vite dev --port 4321
scripts.waitlist:export: wrangler d1 execute explorin-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT email, source, created_at FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at"
